messages:
lia (IC): Hi folks — quick scenario: my due date got pushed and my parental leave now overlaps with the company year-end holiday blackout. I have ~8 hours in my sick bank and 16 hours floating. Can any of those be converted or transferred to cover the blackout week if Im still on leave?

maria (People Ops): Congrats, Lia! Short answer: we can make accommodations but it depends on contract type and whether the blackout week is considered company-paid. If you're on approved paid parental leave, the year-end shutdown is usually treated as company-paid and does not affect your leave bank.

lia (IC): My leave is partly paid (company top-up) and partly unpaid. I was worried because our manager said the shutdown might reduce my leave bank if payroll treats it as unpaid.

jordan (Manager): I asked because team coverage is tight and I wanted to be sure we flagged this early. Would hate for Lia to lose out.

emily (Benefits): From benefits side: parental leave top-up is handled separately from PTO/sick banks. If the leave is active and paid via parental top-up, the holiday week should be applied as company holiday. If payroll sees it as unpaid, we can request an adjustment but need documentation.

_tim (Payroll): Please note payroll processes year-end holiday pay in a separate workflow. If Lia's leave spans the blackout, submit a payroll ticket with leave approval docs and we can code the week as "Company Shutdown - Parental Top-up". Without docs we'll default to the leave coding which could deduct from sick/floating.

maria (People Ops): To be explicit, submit: 1) manager leave approval, 2) HR parental leave approval form, 3) dates of the blackout overlap. Email people-ops@redwood.com and cc payroll. We'll run the exception review.

lia (IC): If I wanted to voluntarily gift my floating hours to a teammate so the team can cover a shift, is that allowed?

emily (Benefits): We do have a voluntary time donation policy for emergencies. It requires donor consent form and manager sign-off. Its typically processed as a transfer of paid hours, not as an accrual change.

jordan (Manager): If Lia is open to gifting, Id like to accept 8 hours to cover a critical standup. Ill fill in the manager approval and link to the donor form.

hr-bot: Reminder: donation forms must be completed 10 business days before payroll cutoff for the transfer to apply that period. :calendar: https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/time-donation

emily (Benefits): Also note donations are final once processed; donors cant reclaim hours later. Payroll will need the signed form + donor email.

lia (IC): Thanks, all. Ill gather the leave docs and decide on the donation. Appreciate the quick help.

maria (People Ops): Happy to assist — ping me if you need help with the forms.
